selection: Port CUDA-like tests that can exercise MetaX MACA, and retain shared helpers required by those tests. CUDA-driver-only, ROCm, XPU, TPU, vendor-specific kernel backend, external eval suite, and vLLM packaging/tooling tests are excluded.
maca_adaptations: Load vllm_metax general plugins during collection so backend and registry unit tests see local implementations.
Expose in-tree test utility and plugin packages when pytest runs from a source checkout.
Treat current_platform.is_cuda_alike() as the CUDA-compatible MACA path.
Map MACA aggregate device-memory queries to torch accelerator memory accounting.
Use MacaPlatform in attention selector and ViT attention tests, with MACA-specific backend and capability expectations.
Skip torchrun-only distributed modules unless a rendezvous environment exists.
Skip NIXL integration modules unless a disaggregated deployment port set is provided.
Guard optional third-party test dependencies with pytest.importorskip().
environment_requirements: Install requirements/test.txt in the selected MetaX Python environment.
Install a Torch 2.13-compatible MetaX kernel provider before running native kernel tests.
Provide model and dataset caches or online Hugging Face access for model-backed tests.
Provide torchrun, Ray, NIXL, or Mooncake deployment environments for their dedicated integration suites.
